Winery Description: BORNOS Vinos & Licores is the meeting point for a new era in the world of wine, where our passion for it translates into innovation and authenticity, merging history with the future. Each of our wineries and their brands come together under a concept that challenges the conventional. While preserving their character, personality, and identity, they are all guided by a unique philosophy. And we do so with a specific goal in mind: to elevate everything we expect from wine through quality, continuous improvement, and excellence, always thinking about what the consumer seeks at every moment. Currently, we bring together seven wineries rooted in six prestigious wine regions of Spain: Palacio de Bornos (D.O. Rueda), Señorío de Sarría (D.O. Navarra), Lleiroso and Dominio de Bornos (D.O. Ribera del Duero), Martínez Corta (D.O.Ca. Rioja), Bucrana (D.O. Toro), and Guelbenzu (Finca la Lombana). To all of this, we add the spirits we produce at Casa D’Aristi, originating from Mexico.

Product 1 Description: Family Collection is a range of limited editions where wine and art come together through the work, passion and inspiration of the winemaker in the cellar and the artist in the studio. In each edition, a winery, an origin and a prestigious artist come together in a unique dialogue, but under the same vision: to create a unique and captivating work that is both wine and art culture. The label of Palacio de Bornos Gran Vino de Rueda Edición Sergio Hernández reproduces the work of the renowned Mexican artist, reflecting, thanks to his unmistakable style full of luminosity and liveliness, the origin of wine: the grape, the bunch. Winery Description: Les Freses Winery is a Boutique winery focused on estate certified organic grapes to produce wines from endemic Valencian varieties under the Alicante appellation where our ancestors had cultivated them for millennia, situated between Dénia and Jávea on the Spanish Levant. Our goal: Mediterranean freshness, full in your palate, low-alcohol and light fresh wines.

Product 1 Description: VITICULTURA 100% moscatel de Alejandría plantado en espaldera a doble guyot sobre suelos arcillosos, con una producción media por hectárea de 4000 kg/ha. Este viñedo de 17 años de 6 ha, solo recibe enmiendas naturales y además de una poda en seco, continuas podas en verde. Vendimiamos manualmente en cajas de 12kg con mesa de selección y despalillado la primera semana de agosto. ELABORACIÓN Y CRIANZA Tras una maceración de 24 h, arranca la fermentación con levaduras propias y la mantenemos con la temperatura controlada a 15ºC en depósitos de inox. Con una ligera filtración y un nivel de sulfitos bajo. NOTAS DE CATA En visual es amarillo pajizo claro, brillante y con reflejos verdes típicos de la moscatel y en nariz es un moscatel lleno de flores frescas, jazmín, flor de azahar, manzanilla, rosa y polvos de talco. En boca, seco totalmente, placentero, citrico con limoncillo, pétalos carnosos y su retrogusto es largo en boca, de hinojo, jengibre y pimienta blanca, salino y toque a pomelo.
Product 2 Description: Una vinificación al estilo de los íberos de s VII ac que colonizaron nuestra comarca, para ofrecer un vino muy de hoy. Un vino que busca ser el mejor reconocimiento a nuestros antepasados y a nuestra tierra. Un visual de oro, limpio y con reflejos brillantes pajizos. Intenso y distinguido con aromas florales en nariz. Complejo, seco y salino en banco.
Product 3 Description: Vinificación sobre lías en damajuanas de 54L.
Product 4 Description: De una pequeña parcela de viñas de más de 70 años, la moscatel se vuelve sabia y tranquila.
Product 5 Description: Las viñas viejas de 70 años nos dan muy pocos racimos que fermentaremos en barricas de roble.
Product 6 Description: Uvas de moscatel, pasificadas en la planta, para un dulce lleno de frutos secos, orejones y mucha tensión.
Product 7 Description: Un coupage 100% valenciano: Giró, Forcallat, Monastrell, Bobal y Tardana. Baja graduación y cuerpo.
Product 8 Description: 100% giró, la garnacha de nuestra comarca, más ligera y menos alcohólica.
Product 9 Description: La variedad Forcallat nos encanta: poco tanino y mucha fruta, poco alcohol y muchas posibilidades de maridaje.
Product 10 Description: In our obsession to find the happiest Muscat vines in our region, we found an "albino" Hamburg Muscat or pink Muscat plant and began vinification soon there after. The Muscat grape family includes about two hundred varieties of the Vitis vinifera grape. The breadth and number of Muscat varieties suggest that it may be the oldest cultivated grape variety in the world, thus an aspiration of Les Freses. After more than twelve years and a huge amount of work by our botanist friend Jaume X. Soler in the laboratory, we managed to plant a vineyard of 400 plants with which we vinify this still rosé on the estate.

Winery Description: Sidras Bereziartua is a family company that has been dedicated to the cider activity since 1870. It was then when we made the first elaborations of Bereziartua Ciders in our old facilities in Ergobia. A century later, in 1970, our cider maker bet definitively for the elaboration of "sagardua" in its current facilities in Astigarraga, the place where we are nowadays. Since then, and after different modernization processes, Bereziartua has become a reference in the elaboration of natural cider maintaining the family character at the service of tradition, respect and gratitude to our loyal customers.

Product 2 Description: The elaboration of this cider is made by blending different wild apples such as Txalaka, Urtebia, Gezamina, etc.... Winery Description: VIÑALESA brings together Spanish family wineries that share the same philosophy: respect for tradition, the vineyard and the origin. A project that unites generations of winegrowers to produce authentic wines, a reflection of the diversity and richness of the different wine-growing territories of Spain.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 114
Product 1 Description: Family vineyards in the fourth generation. Manual harvest. The must obtained during pressing is cooled and clarified by the gravitational method. It is then fermented in stainless steel tanks at low temperature to preserve its aromas. Aged on lees for at least 4 months. The selected vineyards, with an area of 2 hectares, are located on the southwest-facing slopes of the Avia River valley. The planting density is 4,200 vines per hectare. The soils are very poor, with low clay content, but are characterized by a high presence of granitic sand, known as Sabrego, typical of the Ribeiro region. It has a bright yellow color with greenish reflections. It is a very aromatic and fresh wine on the palate, with vibrant notes of white fruit and citrus. With balanced acidity, it is both mineral and fruity.
Product 2 Description: The vines are planted by hand, exclusively in non-forest areas, respecting the trees. The family takes care of the vineyards for years until they begin to bear fruit. They avoid the use of herbicides and practice viticulture in harmony with nature. This meticulous and laborious work is rewarded with a harvest of grapes of exceptional quality, which are picked by hand. The grapes are grown using selective methods and harvested by hand. The must obtained during pressing is cooled and clarified by the gravitational method, and then fermented in stainless steel tanks at a low temperature, thus preserving the varietal aroma of the grapes. It has a yellow color with greenish reflections. Its aroma is vibrant, with notes of apple and green plum, complemented by subtle nuances of fennel and freshly cut grass. On the palate it is refreshing, with a long and fruity finish.
Product 3 Description: Suelos graníticos, arenosos y muy permeables, que permite obtener vinos muy finos, con acidez equilibrada. El entorno de clima atlántico, con temperaturas suaves durante el verano, favorece una maduración lenta y delicada, además de la conservación de los aromas afrutados. Vendimiado a mano, racimo a racimo, en cajas de 15 kg. Fermentado con levaduras de control y su propio pie de cuba, criado y afinado sobre lías en depósito de acero durante 5 meses. En nariz es complejo, con notas a fruta madura y marcados aromas de carácter frutal. Nariz perfumada a cítiricos y manzana verde, plátano, ciruelas, pomelo y ligero fondofloral. En boca destaca por su marcado volumen, untuoso y salino. De acidez contenida y final sutil.
Product 4 Description: Los viñedos se encuentran en la denominación de origen Valdeorras, en Galicia. Esta región está situada en la parte oriental de Galicia y es conocida por su clima y suelos ideales para el cultivo de la uva Godello. Los suelos son diversos, incluyendo pizarra, granito y arcilla, lo que proporciona un buen drenaje y aporta mineralidad a los vinos. Estas condiciones climáticas y de suelo son ideales para las variedades de uva autóctonas, proporcionando a los vinos estructura, acidez brillante y mineralidad, junto con aromas característicos de frutas cítricas. Las uvas se recolectan a mano, racimo por racimo, en cestas de 15 kg. Se realiza una fermentación controlada en depósitos de acero inoxidable y un envejecimiento sobre lías (sur lie) durante 5 meses, con removido periódico (battônnage). El vino presenta un color amarillo limón pálido con reflejos brillantes y de intensidad media. Posee un aroma frutal pronunciado, con notas de cítricos, manzana verde, plátano y ciruela blanca.
Product 5 Name: SEÑORIO DE BEADE, Mencía, DO Ribeiro
Product 5 Description: Los viñedos seleccionados, que abarcan una superficie de 1,5 hectáreas, se encuentran en las laderas del valle del río Avia, en Beade. Los suelos son muy pobres, con bajo contenido de arcilla, pero se caracterizan por la elevada presencia de arena granítica, conocida como Sabrego, típica de la región del Ribeiro. La densidad de plantación es de 5.000 cepas por hectárea. Las uvas se recolectan a mano. Durante la fermentación se realiza batonnage tres veces al día para maximizar la extracción de color de los hollejos. Tras la fermentación maloláctica, el vino se envejece durante 4 meses en depósitos de acero inoxidable antes del embotellado. El vino presenta un color rojo rubí brillante con reflejos violáceos. Su aroma revela un bouquet muy rico con matices frutales. En boca es equilibrado y “vivo”, con un final pronunciado y agradable de mora y frambuesa, complementado con sutiles notas de violetas.
Product 6 Description: El proceso de producción del vino comienza con la vendimia de las uvas en su punto óptimo de maduración. A continuación, las uvas se trituran para liberar su mosto e iniciar la fermentación durante un período de 7 a 14 días, mientras las pieles, semillas y el mosto permanecen en contacto para extraer color y taninos. Tras la fermentación, el vino se prensa para separarlo de los sólidos. En esta etapa, puede realizarse opcionalmente la fermentación maloláctica para reducir la acidez. Color rojo granate con matices violáceos, limpio y brillante. Aromas complejos de frutas maduras bien integrados con sutiles notas especiadas de vainilla y caramelo. Vino redondo y bien equilibrado, con un final suave pero largo.
Product 7 Description: The vineyards cover 7 hectares in the Avia River valley in Beade. The average age of the vines is 25 years. The soils are very poor, with low clay content, but are characterized by the high presence of granite sand known as Sabrego, typical of the Ribeiro region. The mountains isolate the region from the influence of the Atlantic Ocean. A slightly continental climate, combined with prevailing air currents, creates a significant temperature difference between day and night. This promotes the slow maturation of polyphenols, making the wine rich and aromatic. The grapes are handpicked, followed by careful sorting before being sent to the press. Only the first press, known as the "grape tear," is used for winemaking. Decanting is done through the gravitational method. Fermentation takes place at a stable low temperature to preserve all the aromatic qualities of the grapes. The wine has a bright straw color, with an elegant aroma of citrus and white fruits, complemented by floral notes.
Product 8 Description: The 30-hectare estate vineyards are located in the Ribeiro Sacra wine region in the heart of Galicia. The vines have very low yields and are cultivated using traditional terraced farming methods. Grapes are hand-harvested, bunch by bunch, in 12 kg baskets. Controlled fermentation temperature. The wine is aged in stainless steel tanks for a minimum of 5 months before bottling. The wine has a bright cherry color with high intensity and a purple rim. It has a rich aroma with notes of ripe currants, blackberries, wild strawberries, and raspberries, with a subtle floral backdrop of violet. A wine with character. Refreshing on the palate, balanced, complex, and long-lasting. It stands out for its elegance and complexity.
Product 9 Description: The vineyards are located on 1 hectare in the Avia River valley in Beade. The average age of the vines is 20 years. The soils are very poor, with low clay content, but are characterized by the high presence of granite sand known as Sabrego, typical of the Ribeiro region. The grapes are handpicked, followed by careful sorting before being sent to the press. Decanting is done through the gravitational method. Only the first press, known as the "grape tear," is used for winemaking. Fermentation takes place at a stable low temperature to preserve all the aromatic qualities of the grapes. The wine has a bright golden color with greenish reflections. Its elegant floral aroma is complemented by pronounced mineral notes and herbal hints of bay leaf. It has a balanced, refreshing acidity, and is complex and full-bodied on the palate with a long finish.
Product 10 Description: The vineyards are located at an altitude of 750 meters above sea level, with vines that are 30–50 years old. The grapes are harvested mechanically. Afterward, they undergo quality control and are sent to the press. The harvest starts early September. Fermentation occurs in stainless steel tanks under temperature control over 10-14 days to preserve all the aromatic qualities of the grapes. This vibrant and versatile wine has a deep ruby-red color with a velvety hue. It captivates with its rich aroma of forest fruits, blackberry, and subtle spicy notes of black pepper. The taste is rounded with good structure and is accompanied by a long, pleasant fruity aftertaste.

Winery Description: At 3 Terruños we make organic D.O.P. Jumilla wines together with winegrowers who work the land in a sustainable way. We select grapes from different places and vinify them with modern techniques and minimal intervention, so that each wine preserves the essence of the variety and honestly expresses the landscape where is coming from. *** Respect for the environment: We prioritize ecological practices in the vineyard and winery, reducing our impact: sustainable vineyards, responsible management of resources and clean processes that allow nature to express itself with purity. *** Artisanal quality: We work with limited batches with an artisanal approach, combining the experience of small winegrowers and oenological precision to create honest wines with their own character in each variety. *** Constant innovation: We explore new terroirs, winemaking methods and ageing, integrating current tools without sacrificing our essence: minimal intervention and maximum expression of the origin.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 252
Product 1 Description: Monovarietal airén organic wine, made with a cold maceration with its skins for 3 days and slow fermentation at low temperature in stainless steel tanks to preserve its varietal character to the maximum. It comes from a unique place in La Hoya de Torres, DOP Jumilla, with old vines on ungrafted feet located at an altitude of more than 800 metres. Production limited to 1,487 bottles and aged for more than 5 months in used 225 liters French oak barrels. It has a bright golden color. On the nose it is intense and complex, with a range of apples ranging from fresh fruit to roasted apple and cider, accompanied by delicate touches of fine wood, bay leaf, ripe citrus and peach, with subtle hints of honey and light smoky nuances. On the palate it has great volume and well-integrated acidity, it is enveloping, sapid and slightly liqueur, with a creamy texture and a very long, persistent and aromatic finish that invites you to continue drinking.
Product 2 Description: Coming from old ungrafted vines located at an altitude of more than 800 metres, it is aged for eleven months in used French oak barrels. It is the deepest and most serious wine of the house, with great structure, outstanding minerality and remarkable aging capacity. Very limited production: only 1,151 bottles. It has a dark cherry color with a bright garnet rim. On the nose it displays a precise and elegant intensity, with blackberries and ripe cherries in the foreground, accompanied by fine spices, Mediterranean mountain herbs and subtle hints of fine cabinetry. On the palate it is juicy and sapid, with excellent balance, polished tannins and light toasted touches perfectly integrated. The good acidity provides nerve and balsamic freshness, culminating in a long, elegant, persistent finish of marked complexity.
Product 3 Description: It is an organic Mediterranean coupage of 70% Garnacha Tintorera from the Gamellón area, 15% Monastrell and 15% Airén. We seek to maintain the maturity and depth of the Garnacha Tintorera, providing fluidity and color stability thanks to the Airén. Monastrell adds acidity and aromatic complexity, with more red fruit and spicy nuances. It completes a seven-month aging in barrels, mainly French and American, to integrate the wood without detracting from the fruit. It has a very covered cherry colour, with a deep bluish rim and dense tears. On the nose it is shown with high intensity, very expressive, with abundant very ripe black and red fruit, hints of blackberries and plums, balsamic that refresh the whole, delicate notes of blue flowers and a marked mineral background with subtle iodized and saltpeter nuances. On the palate it is broad and juicy, tasty and powerful but fluid, with polished tannins, good acidity and a very long, enveloping and aromatic finish.

Winery Description: Behind Saíñas are Jorge and Saleta, a couple of electrical engineers, guided by the winemaker Luis Seabra. We left a life full of travels, science, and light to return to our homeland and continue with a family project. This is a story full of challenges but also filled with love. Love for wine, love for the land, and love for well-made things. Our name is due to an old vineyard called SAÍÑAS, recovered on the banks of the Cabe River, in the heart of the Ribeira Sacra. Our brand image is not by chance but represents the terraces or "socalcos" that our ancestors sculpted on the river hillsides to enable grape cultivation. Specifically, the incline of the name, and that stepped form coincides with the slope and terraces of our SAÍÑAS vineyard. For our wines, we use only grapes grown on our own vines, cultivated sustainably and carefully hand-harvested. As winegrowers, our wines are intimately connected to the land from which they originate. The result is wines faithful to our principles and our way of understanding viticulture, expressing in a unique way the identity of the terroir they come from.

Product 1 Description: El primer Treixadura del mundo criado en ánforas de granito extraído del propio viñedo en el que se cultiva. Allí donde la viña convive con la piedra y el tiempo avanza despacio , la Treixadura alcanza su equilibrio natural. El resultado: un vino de gran pureza, marcada mineralidad y una elegancia que perdura.
